rows.note: This is the all-purpose rendering for muscle tissue or an individual muscle organ.

example.jyutping: ngo5 laai1 soeng1 zo2 daai6 teoi2 gei1 juk6

rows.note: Use this for strength or leverage in a general, non-physical sense rather than for body muscles.

example.english: The company has the muscle to take on its rivals.
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jau5 sat6 lik6 tung4 deoi3 sau2 dau3

rows.note: Use this phrase for a muscular physique developed through exercise.

example.english: They’ve worked out for years and developed a body packed with muscle.
example.traditional: 佢操咗幾年，練到一身肌肉。
example.jyutping: keoi5 cou1 zo2 gei2 nin4 lin6 dou3 jat1 san1 gei1 juk6

rows.note: Use this for a hired tough or enforcer rather than for strength itself.

example.english: Those guys are the boss’s hired muscle.
example.traditional: 嗰班人係老闆請返嚟做打手嘅。
example.jyutping: go2 baan1 jan4 hai6 lou5 baan2 cing2 faan1 lei4 zou6 daa2 sau2 ge3
